_comment: Known-and-accepted HIGH/CRITICAL advisories for the TypeScript/JS dependency graph, as reported by `pnpm audit --json`. The dependency-audit workflow FAILS on any HIGH/CRITICAL advisory that is NOT listed here, so a newly published advisory blocks a merge on the day it lands. Entries are not permanent: each names the direct dependent that pulls the package in and the surface it is reachable from, so the fix is always "upgrade that dependent", never "extend this file".
_policy: HIGH/CRITICAL -> fail unless listed; MEDIUM/LOW -> reported, not enforced. Mirrors the six non-TS tiers in the same workflow.

_surfaces.test-tooling: Reachable only from the test runner. Not published, not reachable from a compiled contract.
_surfaces.release-tooling: Reachable only while cutting a release, on repo-authored input.
_surfaces.compiler-runtime: A dependency of a PUBLISHED package that runs in the compiler process. Not on-chain surface, but it does run on a user machine over the user’s own source.
_surfaces.mixed: More than one of the above.
